spec_match.rationale: Walks the real replacement path: hasStorageAccess() probe, requestStorageAccess() request, cookie write with SameSite=None; Secure, and read-back verification — the exact API surface that survives the RWS removal.

interactive.rationale: Four numbered steps each with a real button and live output pane.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card: the recommended path off RWS walked end to end, same surface Safari and Firefox ship.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported-API, rejection, and cookie-blocked branches each render distinct honest messages; the 'why this works without RWS' section explains the prompt returning post-removal.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5194473869017088 and MDN Storage Access API.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 suite asserts the surviving surfaces this walkthrough uses (requestStorageAccess, hasStorageAccess true top-level, storage-access permission, SameSite cookie write).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run passed desktop+mobile (screenshots read). CDP sweep ran all four steps: probe true, request resolved, cookie written and read back, verify consistent — zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; every step outputs explicit ok/bad text.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; step numbers use the display font; ok/bad colours pair with text on paper backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons per step, textual outputs, logical heading/step structure readable in source order.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the step grid (2rem + 1fr) holds at 360px without overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Async step results should be exposed as text adjacent to their triggering control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each step's .out pane is a text region directly under its button; ok/bad states include words, not colour alone.

summary: v153 refile of storage-access-migration (milestone references updated; behaviour unchanged — the page was already accurate about the post-RWS prompt semantics). Verified via the responsive harness and a CDP walkthrough of all four steps with zero console errors.
